author: (A. d'Orbigny, 1842)

note.en: A small rocky-shore top snail recorded at the Limón port ramp in 1992. Found on rocks at the waterline, it is only a regional record.
note.es: Un caracol trompo pequeño de orilla rocosa registrado en la rampa del puerto de Limón en 1992. Vive en rocas a nivel del agua; es solo un registro regional.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
Puerto Limón 1992: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
